component.name: liteavd
component.summary: Local Android multi-device workspace for Linux

description.p: liteavd runs official Android Virtual Devices side by side in a native GTK workspace. Each managed device has an embedded low-latency viewport, isolated input focus, and explicit per-device operation results.

It can adopt an existing Android SDK or prepare a private SDK without Java tooling after showing the applicable Google license. Resource-aware scheduling keeps console ports, launch concurrency, memory, and GPU use explicit.

The standard audio socket plays only the focused managed device's guest speaker stream. A focused device can receive a WAV file or host microphone through an explicit, default-off virtual microphone action; host input is never opened implicitly.
This is a pre-alpha build intended for testing and feedback, not a stable production release.

Initial pre-alpha with a multi-device workspace, embedded share-vid viewports, authenticated input, audio focus, explicit virtual microphone sources, APK and file deployment, snapshots, logs, and a zero-Java managed SDK path.
